security_audit.summary: Most static command hits are Markdown fences, inline CLI names, or documentation examples rather than dynamic shell execution. Confirmed risks are limited to third-party CLI installation guidance, belt commands that call external generation services, and remote processing of prompts or app imagery.

remediation.issue: External CLI and skill installation commands
remediation.suggestion: Move npx installation steps behind explicit user confirmation and pin trusted sources or versions where possible.

remediation.issue: Remote processing of app prompts and images
remediation.suggestion: Add a privacy note telling users not to submit confidential screenshots, unreleased UI, credentials, or customer data without approval.
Prefer stable release documentation or a pinned commit URL for installation instructions.

content.user_title: Create App Store Screenshots That Convert
content.value_statement: Store screenshots must meet strict platform specs and communicate value fast. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through sizing, ordering, captions, mockups, and preview video planning.
actual_capabilities: Lists iOS screenshot dimensions for key iPhone and iPad sizes.
Lists Google Play screenshot, feature graphic, and format requirements.
Recommends first-three gallery order and content priorities.
Provides caption writing rules and benefit-focused examples.
Gives belt CLI examples for mockups, callouts, stitching, and preview videos.
Summarizes localization, A/B testing, and common screenshot mistakes.
limitations: Requires the external belt CLI and an inference.sh account for generation examples.
Store requirements can change, so users should verify current Apple and Google rules.
Does not validate actual image files or upload assets to stores.
Generated visuals need human review for brand accuracy and policy compliance.

use_cases.title: Prepare an iOS Launch Gallery
use_cases.description: Plan screenshot sizes, order, captions, and hero messaging for a new App Store release.

use_cases.title: Refresh Google Play Assets
use_cases.description: Create a concise asset plan for screenshots, feature graphics, and preview media before a listing update.

use_cases.title: Localize Store Screenshots
use_cases.description: Prioritize markets and decide where captions, screenshots, and gallery order need local adaptation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Screenshot Gallery
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for one app store.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a screenshot gallery for my mobile app. The app is [app type], the top benefit is [benefit], and the target store is [Apple App Store or Google Play].

prompt_templates.title: Write Benefit Captions
prompt_templates.prompt: Create benefit-focused captions for these app screens: [screen list]. Keep each caption readable in a store screenshot and limit it to two lines.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Mockup Prompts
prompt_templates.scenario: Asset generation with the belt workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft belt-compatible image generation prompts for a screenshot set. Include a hero mockup, a feature callout, and a lifestyle context image for [app details].

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Full Listing Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before launch or A/B testing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned store screenshot strategy for [app]. Check platform fit, first-three impact, caption clarity, localization needs, and A/B testing opportunities.

output_examples.input: I need screenshots for a habit tracker on iOS.
output_examples.output: Recommended gallery: hero outcome first, weekly progress second, reminders third, social proof fourth, and customization screens later.

output_examples.input: My Google Play listing needs a better first screenshot.
output_examples.output: Lead with the clearest user benefit, use one short caption, show the app in use, and reserve settings screens for later positions.

output_examples.input: I want to localize screenshots for three markets.
output_examples.output: Prioritize translated captions for all markets, then rebuild screenshots where culture, examples, currency, or device language affects comprehension.

best_practices: Start with the strongest user outcome in the first screenshot.
Keep captions short, benefit-focused, and readable at store thumbnail sizes.
Verify dimensions and media rules against current store documentation before submission.
anti_patterns: Using onboarding or settings screens as the first screenshots.
Writing feature labels when a user benefit would be clearer.
Submitting generated visuals without checking brand accuracy and store policy fit.

faq.question: Does this skill create final store assets by itself?
faq.answer: It provides planning guidance and belt CLI generation examples. Users still need to review, resize, and submit final assets.

faq.question: Which stores does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Apple App Store and Google Play screenshot guidance, including dimensions, gallery limits, and preview media notes.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require external services?
faq.answer: Yes. Generation examples require the belt CLI and inference.sh access.

faq.question: Can it help with localization?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests market priorities and when to translate captions or rebuild screenshots.

faq.question: Can it validate Apple or Google approval?
faq.answer: No. It gives preparation guidance, but users must verify current platform rules and review assets before submission.
